impact_assessment.why: the last visual pass was three days ago and a fresh review found real layout, readability and map-legibility defects on the shipping screens
impact_assessment.benefits: clean 1280x720 and 1024x640 surfaces, an informative map, and readable boss/flow HUD without regressing the established style
impact_assessment.risks: contract: DOM/CSS only plus map canvas drawing and HUD text; dependency: none; concurrency: single-threaded; state: no save or sim schema changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: limit changes to presentation, keep sim untouched, re-screenshot every affected screen at both sizes, run 121 tests plus all 7 project gates

checkpoints.description: [4/4] Implemented and verified: checkpoint rows keep full section names (tag moved to note line), balanced centered card rows, map fills the canvas with a complete legend, boss bar has a name plate + HP %, idle Flow reads FLOW · IDLE, menu scrims hide the HUD, and the title menu has a backing panel with a disabled-Continue explanation. One vision subagent confirmed all targeted items FIXED with no new P0/P1; 121 tests, lint, typecheck, build and 7/7 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'visual-qa-2026-10-29' completed successfully.

[1/5] Plan: rebuild the Sanctuary as a village - five NPC buildings with facades and door labels, a dedicated lit interior per building, and a spotlight that blacks out the rest of the sanctuary while inside; wire prompts, fade, tests and docs

impact_assessment.why: the Sanctuary still reads as one flat hall with five NPCs standing in the open, and the user wants real buildings, separate interiors and door signage
impact_assessment.benefits: a legible hub with architecture, distinct interiors for every resident, and a clear inside/outside state
impact_assessment.risks: contract: InteractableKind, Sanctuary layout constants, World sanctuary mode, Renderer focus layer; dependency: none; concurrency: single-threaded; state: no save schema change, but a save inside a building must not strand the player on reload
impact_assessment.mitigation: keep building state in World only (never persisted), always spawn outside on load, add sim tests for enter/exit and label/prop uniqueness, verify with Playwright screenshots

checkpoints.description: [2/5] Re-scope: replace the walkable village square with a UI Sanctuary hub (building cards with facade art, stations, Set Out), and keep only each resident's interior as a walkable world entered from the hub; exit returns to the hub UI. Removes the square layout, walking-to-door prompts and the spotlight, adds per-building rooms and a sanctuary backdrop.

impact_assessment.why: the user judged the walkable square unprofessional; a UI hub reads cleanly and still keeps the interiors as real playable rooms
impact_assessment.benefits: a crisp hub screen, each resident in a real room, simpler sim (one room per world), and no camera/spotlight complexity
impact_assessment.risks: contract: World options and sanctuary exports, sanctuary event flow, hub screen; dependency: none; concurrency: single-threaded; state: hub is never persisted, entering a room always spawns at that room's entrance
impact_assessment.mitigation: rewrite sanctuary layout and tests together, keep station ids stable for the rebuild ledger, verify hub and all five interiors with Playwright and one vision reviewer

checkpoints.description: [5/5] Delivered: Sanctuary is now a UI hub (facade cards for all five residents, restoration ledger, Places and Expedition panels, footer), and every resident has a real walkable 21x13 interior with themed furniture, a resident to talk to, and a door back to the hub. Removed the walkable square, spotlight, door toggling and station prompt handling. Verified hub-to-room-to-dialogue-to-room and door-to-hub flows with Playwright; 131 tests and 7/7 project gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'sanctuary-buildings' completed successfully.

[1/4] Plan: add two mechanical Sanctuary places - The Reliquary (attune one owned relic to start every expedition) and The Cairn (spend echoes to bank starting shards) - and give each resident room its own palette, lighting and themed environment props so the five interiors read as five different places

impact_assessment.why: the hub currently has four places and the rooms share one sanctuary palette, so they look like the same room with different furniture
impact_assessment.benefits: two more long-term decisions in the hub and five visually distinct interiors built from one art pipeline
impact_assessment.risks: contract: SanctuaryStation ids, Meta schema defaults, LevelView/tileTextures optional theme, createExpedition starting shards; dependency: generated props; concurrency: single-threaded; state: new Meta fields need defaults so old saves load
impact_assessment.mitigation: add every new Meta field with a zod default, keep station ids additive, test attunement/offerings as pure functions, verify each room with Playwright screenshots and one vision reviewer

checkpoints.description: [4/4] Delivered: two mechanical places (Reliquary attunement, Cairn echo offerings) with tests and meta defaults; five interiors now use distinct biome materials plus themed furniture sets and eight new generated props; hub cards carry prop badges; a single vision review drove fixes for label collision, hint contrast, floating/clipping props, glyph bleed and CTA contrast. 135 tests, 7/7 gates pass. checklists: passed
